text: Does a man in business gain by crushing a competitor? No, destructive competition benefits no one. The kind of competition which results in the defeat of the many and the overlordship of the ruthless few must go. Destructive competition lacks the qualities out of which progress comes. Progress comes from a generous form of rivalry.
author: Henry Ford
reference: My Life and Work (with Samuel Crowther)
locator: Chapter XIX, What We May Expect
